_comment: Local-only launcher binding. Copy/edit as tools/guardian/scheduler.config.json; the file is gitignored and must never contain secrets.
_usage: First scheduler start is interactive and persists one mode: strict keeps the canonical target clean; worktree creates a persistent clean control worktree plus a separate QA snapshot for tracked dirty diff and explicitly selected runtime inputs. Later starts do not ask again. -Yes cannot invent a missing choice; -DryRun fails closed without prompting or creating paths.
